criteria.evidence: Recommends creating a read-only role with SELECT only, restricted to specific tables/views for sensitive data, plus statement timeout and read-only transaction default.
Explicitly says "don't give the agent the admin credentials directly" and explains why; uses admin creds only once to create a limited role.
Restricts the tool via read-only role, read-only env URL, and in custom tools rejecting anything but a single SELECT; fallback includes allowlist of read-only operations, read replica, and logging.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
